summary: Offers advice on how to host a successful IETF Birds-of-a-Feather session, particularly one aimed at forming a working group, based on the experience of the authors with many BOFs that worked or failed. This is an informational document.

eli5.summary: Before a new club can start, people hold a first meeting. This memo gives tips for making that first meeting go well.

questions: how to run a successful ietf bof
